g.text: GTA-AVT ratio-r2: recorded main-run training and fixed-patch validation
Main run: AR_GDF | Raw sampled TRAIN scalars and original VAL observations; no smoothing
base_warm 20k | base 30k | condition 10k | gdf_head 2k | geometry 20k | refine 10k
VAL64: eight fixed patches per case, averaged within case and then across eight cases. These are not native whole-case metrics.
The x-axis records executed workflow updates, including 2k head-only updates; it is not selected-weight lineage. Phase resets are not joined.
The selected base checkpoint is step27k after warm20k; later phases inherit it. Total-loss scales differ by supervision and weight schedule.
